case.summary: Customer C02354 disputed $39.08 charge (2016-11-27), claiming unauthorized. Graph showed three in-person transactions totaling $124.08 in region 126.0 from 2016-11-24 through 2016-11-27. Card has 540 prior transactions in region; cardholder denies merchant or device knowledge. Prior fraud history: 12 confirmed cases. Match flags M5, M6 mismatched. Customer denial raised fraud probability from 0.71 to 0.92, consistent with account takeover. Verdict: fraud confirmed. Card blocked per Policy R2; case created; exposure $124.08 below SAR threshold.
